_comment: World/topology MANIFEST — read by Caelum at boot (packages/firmament/src/caelum). Thin on purpose: which worlds exist, each world's zone list + starting zone. Per-zone detail (tick, map, spawns, portals) lives in content/zones/<id>/. Caelum validates the whole graph at boot (every zone has a bundle + map; every portal resolves to a real zone + named spawn) — dangling topology fails boot. docs/REFACTOR.md S2.
_assets_comment: GLOBAL server-driven asset mapping handed to the client on zone join (NOT per-world — a monster/entity isn't tied to a location). The client is a generic renderer: it fetches art from `base` and renders entity `kind` → the mapped sprite id. `kinds` here holds only NON-monster entities (e.g. player); monster sprites travel with their stats in content/mobs.json and Caelum merges them into this map. `base` is a dev static path now; a CDN (+ the parked encryption) later. Per-zone LOOK (tileset) will live in content/zones/<id>/zone.json.
_respawn_comment: GLOBAL respawn sim defaults (not per-monster/per-zone). `scatter` = world-unit radius a respawn lands within, around its spawn anchor, when the zone's spawn row doesn't override it; `corpseOverlapMs` = how long the fresh mob overlaps its corpse before the body is flushed (no teleport flicker). Per-monster respawnDelayMs lives in content/mobs.json; per-spawn scatter override lives in content/zones/<id>/zone.json.
